name: LANE_ARROWS_STRAIGHT_STRAIGHT_RIGHT_RIGHT_GREEN_LONG
notes: 20 green edge + 20 white border (40). Arrows: 184|176|140|30|59|322|59|30|101|254|145. Straight arrows 150|700|250 vertical; right-turn arrow 285|565|250. Dashed lane lines 30 wide: 100|200|150|200|150|200|100 (dashes at y 100, 450, 800).

g9-43_arrow_straight.desc: straight-ahead lane arrow 176 wide x 700 tall (600 tall on G9-43-3, same head): head 176 wide, head length 114, barb return 16, shaft 40 wide, R8 tip and barb corners; grid 75

g9-43_arrow_straight_and_right.desc: straight-ahead arrow with a right-turn branch, overall 322 wide x 700 tall (600 on G9-43-3): straight arrow as g9-43_arrow_straight (176 wide, head 114/16, shaft 40, R8); branch leaves the shaft 475 above the bottom (bend R100 inner), branch head 176 tall x 114 long with 16 barb return, R8; branch head top 225 below the arrow top; grid 75

g9-43_arrow_right_turn.desc: right-turn arrow 254 wide x 565 tall (730 on G9-43-2, 700 on G9-43-4): vertical shaft 40 wide on the left (357 straight below the bend on G9-43-1, 492 on G9-43-4, 522 on G9-43-2), bend R100 (inner), horizontal head 176 tall x 114 long with 16 barb return, head top 208 below the arrow top, R8 tip and barbs; grid 75

g9-43_arrow_left_turn.desc: left-turn arrow 254 wide x 630 tall (550 on G9-43-4): mirror of g9-43_arrow_right_turn - shaft 40 wide on the right (422 below the bend on G9-43-2, 342 on G9-43-4), bend R100, head 176 tall x 114 long, 16 barb return, head top 208 below the top, R8 typ.; grid 82.5 (G9-43-2) / 105 (G9-43-4)

g9-43_arrow_left_and_right.desc: double (left and right) turn arrow 468 wide x 730 tall: single vertical shaft 40 wide centred, 522 below the bends, bends R100 both sides, heads 176 tall x 114 long with 16 barb return, R8 typ.; grid 82.5

g9-43_arrow_straight_offset.desc: straight-ahead arrow with an S-jog, overall 285 wide x 700 tall: head 176 wide x 114 long with 16 barb return at the top right (head axis 88 from the right edge), R8; shaft 40 wide, upper leg 285 tall, jog at 40 deg (R90 upper bend, R50 lower bend) over 149 tall shifting 177 to the left, lower leg 266 tall ending 20 from the left edge; grid 105
